archetypes.name: oos-reconciler
archetypes.rationale: Fate-adjusted scoring relies on tolerant run-log joins and dedupe semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the analyze_issues OOS run-log parser and scorer for missed evidence forms, over-broad issue-number extraction, duplicate counting, and stable-id collision handling. Pay special attention to cap-rollup expansion, design OOS_FILE_MAP joins, and reviewer attribution. Confirm ambiguous cases degrade rather than guessing. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: gh-fate-fetch
archetypes.rationale: Live analysis now performs optional targeted gh issue view enrichment.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the live analyze-issues fetch path for repo forwarding, retry behavior when optional gh fields are unsupported, targeted issue-view enrichment only for filed OOS candidates, and offline JSON staying network-free by default. Check that fetch failures degrade the fate section without aborting legacy report assembly. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: scoring-contract-docs
archetypes.rationale: The change deliberately separates live voting points from diagnostic fate-adjusted reporting.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the docs and skill prose against the implemented behavior. Ensure live voting remains provisional and unchanged, combined-away markers are documented as machine-readable close comments, and the analyze-issues flags and diagnostic-only guarantee are stated consistently. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
